verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents mapping projects across teams, tracking work in one place, sharing target dates, and visualizing Epics on a Roadmap. Together these support coordinating cross-team launches, but nothing in the evidence describes dependency tracking itself. missing for 10: explicit dependency/blocker relationships between stories, epics or teams; dependency visualization; documentation of dependency workflows for launches; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches

citations.quote: Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
Create goals, align teams, and connect individual projects to company objectives.
